label_policy.primary_binary_metrics: selective: exclude abstained, unlabeled and failed cases; report all exclusions
label_policy.recall_with_abstentions: positive abstentions and failed positive cases count as missed positives
label_policy.four_label_confusion_matrix: all successful labeled cases, including review ground truth/predictions
label_policy.grounded_claim_rate: Gate 2 grounded candidate claims / all candidate claims over all verdict attempts
label_policy.evidence_recall: micro expected signal matches; default FAIL, or explicit expected_results
label_policy.percentiles: linear interpolation: rank=(n-1)*p, successful analysis-only durations

scope: P0 validation on DEV; selective metrics, not a production benchmark
